ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-1,
Community Shopping Districts and indications as shown on Map No. 206-B in the area
bound by:

the alley next north of and parallel to East 103" Street; South Prairie Avenue; East 103”
Street; and, a line 133.48 feet west of and parallel to South Prairie Avenue

to those of a RS2, Residential Single Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
